summary: The ansible.builtin.vars lookup returns the templated value of variables by name, and only works with top-level variable names.
questions: How do I get a variable's value when its name is built dynamically?
Can I reference a variable by a computed name string?
Does the vars lookup handle nested keys like a.b.c?

answer_card.title: Get variable values dynamically with the vars lookup
answer_card.answer_md: `lookup('ansible.builtin.vars', 'name')` returns the templated value of the variable named by a string, useful when the name is computed. Only **top-level** names are supported; access nested keys on the result (e.g. `.sub_var`).
